children.name: pc:views/bpm/processInstance
children.description: The pc:views/bpm/processInstance screen (8 files, 2313 LOC) is the PC workflow process-instance interface. Its detail.vue excerpt shows one card per approval task. Each card offers approve, reject, return-for-correction and terminate actions. A withdraw option is shown only to the initiator, and timesheet processes get a restart path. The names index.vue, create.vue, WithdrawDialog.vue and ApprovalDecisionDialog.vue suggest list, launch and dialog flows, but the excerpt does not confirm them. It calls pc:api/bpm, pc:api/project and pc:api/system, and is called by pc:views/accounting/travel.

children.name: fst:application/expense
children.description: The fst:application/expense module (21358 LOC, 247 files) runs travel expense workflows. Its use cases cover travel applications and revisions, drafting and confirming expense allocations, approvals, month statement approval, and full organization synchronization with an external travel platform. That sync handles departments first, then employees, then retiring departments. It has 26 outgoing edges, including calls to bpm:api/task, bpm:api/mq, fst:domain/expense, fst:infrastructure/platform, system:api/user and system:api/dept. It reads and writes ds:bpm_oa_customized and ds:psa_reliable_delivery_task. Its 6 callers include fst:controller/admin/expense, fst:controller/app/expense, fst:mq/consumer and fst:trigger/task.

children.name: fst:controller/admin/expense
children.description: The fst:controller/admin/expense module (87 files, 4721 LOC) is the admin HTTP layer for travel expenses. It includes controllers such as TravelApplicationController, TravelExpenseAllocationController and MonthStatementApprovalController. It also has converters like TravelExpenseAllocationHttpConverter, which turn payloads into commands such as SaveTravelExpenseAllocationCommand. It has 14 OUTGOING edges, calling fst:application/expense, fst:domain/expense, fst:expense/travel, bpm:api/annotation and framework:security, among others. It both reads and writes ds:bpm_oa_customized. Its 2 INCOMING edges are dispatch from h5:api/fst and pc:api/accounting.

children.name: fst:domain/expense
children.description: The fst:domain/expense module has 154 files and 11723 LOC. Its largest file, TravelApplication.java, is the aggregate root for travel applications. It creates DRAFT applications and checks that each document number follows the "TR-" pattern. It sorts the TravelApplicationLine entries and works out planStartTime and planEndTime from them. Other files include Invoice.java, MonthStatementApproval.java and ExpenseAllocationLine.java. Outgoing, it calls framework:common, fst:enums/registry and fst:expense/travel. Incoming, it is called by fst:application/expense, fst:controller/admin/expense, fst:infrastructure/bpm and fst:infrastructure/expense.

children.name: fst:infrastructure/expense
children.description: fst:infrastructure/expense (216 files, 26421 LOC) appears to be the persistence and external-platform adapter layer for travel expenses. It includes repositories such as TravelApplicationRepositoryImpl and InvoiceRepositoryImpl, plus Fenbeitong clients and materializers such as FenbeitongOrgSynchronizationClient and FenbeitongOrderFactMaterializer. The excerpted TravelPlatformOrgSynchronizationRepositoryImpl records organization-sync runs on "master", and a fenceToken decides which writer may write. The module has 155 OUTGOING edges, including bpm:api/task, fst:domain/expense, fst:dal/mysql/project and system:api/dept. Its 2 INCOMING callers are fst:application/expense and fst:controller/app/expense.

children.name: h5:pages/work/travel
children.description: The h5:pages/work/travel node is a mobile screen in psa-mini/src/pages/work/travel (LOC 5039, 29 files) for business travel applications. In form.tsx, users enter trips with cities, a business object, start and end times, and a purpose. The screen calls saveTravelApplicationDraft, submitTravelApplication and createTravelApplicationRevision. Approval screens include TravelApplicationApproval.tsx and TravelExternalApproval.tsx. It calls h5:api/fst, h5:api/process and h5:api/system, and h5:pages/index calls it. The excerpt covers only form.tsx, so the other files' behavior is unconfirmed.

children.name: fst:application/cost
children.description: fst:application/cost is a 20721-LOC, 354-file module whose file names (OpeningHealthCheckUseCase.java, CostCollectionBatchOrchestratorImpl.java, CarryBatchService.java, LaborReclassRunUseCase.java, QueryProjectProfitUseCase.java, QueryWipReportUseCase.java) suggest it runs project-cost opening checks, cost collection, allocation, carry batches, labor reclassification and profit/WIP reporting. Among its 58 outgoing edges, it calls fst:service/cost, fst:domain/cost, fst:mq/producer and fst:dal/mysql/accounting. It reads ds:mdm_accounting_period, ds:psa_carry_batch and ds:psa_carry_batch_line, and the packet lists no write edges. It is called by fst:controller/admin/cost, fst:mq/consumer, fst:trigger/task, fst:application/accounting and fst:infrastructure/cost.

children.name: fst:controller/admin/cost
children.description: fst:controller/admin/cost is the HTTP entry layer for cost carry-forward (成本结转) work, with 118 files and 7679 LOC. In the excerpt, CostCollectionController sits at "/fst/cost/collection" and serves collection summaries, ledger and pool drill-downs, and Excel exports, all behind 'cost:collection:query'; its header says it holds no business rules. Its 18 outgoing edges call fst:application/cost, fst:service/cost, fst:domain/cost, fst:infrastructure/cost, system:api/user and framework modules, and it reads ds:psa_cost_recon_disposition. It is called by fst:application/cost and fst:service/cost, and pc:api/accounting dispatches to it.

children.name: fst:domain/cost
children.description: fst:domain/cost is a 267-file, 10441-LOC module that holds the cost-accounting domain logic. Its largest classes include OhAllocationCalculator, PostingRuleEngine, CostCollectionBatch and CarryBatch. From these, it appears to handle OH allocation onto project timesheet basis, posting rules, cost collection and carry batches. It makes calls to framework:common and fst:cost/projectcost. Seven nodes call into it: fst:application/accounting, fst:application/cost, fst:controller/admin/cost, fst:infrastructure/cost, fst:mq/consumer, fst:service/cost and fst:service/costsummaryext.

children.name: fst:infrastructure/cost
children.description: fst:infrastructure/cost is a module of 14818 LOC across 266 files that holds the data-access and posting code for project costs. Its largest file, PostingVoucherDrafterImpl.java, builds accounting voucher drafts from carry lines using PostingRuleProvider and PostingRuleEngine. The file names WipLedgerPosterImpl.java, CostSummaryViewReader.java and ProfitReportMapper.java suggest it also covers WIP, cost-summary and profit reporting. It has 150 outgoing edges, including calls to framework:mybatis, fst:domain/cost, fst:dal/mysql/accounting, fst:service/manhour and system:api/dept, and it reads ds:annual_bonus_detail and ds:arbad. It is called by fst:application/cost, fst:controller/admin/cost, fst:service/cost and fst:service/costsummaryext.

children.name: fst:service/costsummaryext
children.description: fst:service/costsummaryext has 3221 LOC in 16 files and appears to import finance cost corrections, through CostCorrectionImportService, and overhead expenses, through OhExpenseImportService. The import service creates a batch for each upload and returns its number at once. A background job then parses only the "全部" and "删除" sheets in chunks of 2000 rows. The module reads psa_cost_summary, psa_cost_summary_history, psa_cost_summary_ext_import_batch, psa_pm_project and other tables. It writes psa_cost_summary and mdm_accounting_period. It calls fst:service/cost, fst:service/dept and infra:api/file. fst:application/cost and fst:controller/admin/cost call it.

children.name: pc:api/accounting
children.description: pc:api/accounting is the PC front-end's accounting API layer: 2452 LOC across 29 files in psa-front-desk-pc/src/api/accounting. It covers cost and revenue accounting operations such as costCarryPosting, revenueRedReversal, costOpening, costCollection, costCorrection, voucherManage and wipManualWriteOff. The costCarryPosting.mock.js excerpt sets USE_MOCK = false, so those calls go to the real backend. The module dispatches to fst:controller/admin/accounting, fst:controller/admin/cost and fst:controller/admin/expense. It is called by 22 views, including pc:views/accounting/costCarry, pc:views/accounting/voucherManage and pc:views/costopenning/costCorrection.

children.name: pc:views/accounting/costCarry
children.description: pc:views/accounting/costCarry is a 1788-LOC screen for managing costCarry batches. In BatchDetailDrawer.vue, a batch shows its batchNo, carryType, periodName, voucherNos, entryCount and totalAmount. A progress bar compares baselineCount with processedCount. A rerun button needs cost:carry-batch:confirm, and the summary export needs cost:carry-batch:query. The screen's other files are index.vue, BatchTable.vue, StepPipeline.vue, format.js and TrialDialog.vue. It calls pc:api/accounting and pc:views/accounting/components, and pc:views/accounting/revenueRedReversal calls it.

children.name: pc:views/accounting/costCollection
children.description: pc:views/accounting/costCollection is a 2695-LOC PC screen for collecting period costs. Users filter by company and period, then run executeCollection and confirmCollection. They review the direct-cost ledger tab and the indirect pool tab. They handle collection exceptions with recheckEntryError and exemptEntryError, import OH data (pageOhImportDetails, revokeOhImportRows) and view getLaborReclassSummary. It calls pc:api/accounting, pc:api/project, pc:api/system and pc:views/accounting/components. It has 8 INCOMING call edges, including pc:views/accounting/costAllocation, pc:views/accounting/costBatchPosting, pc:views/accounting/costPrePostingCheck and pc:views/costopenning.

children.name: pc:views/accounting/travel
children.description: The pc:views/accounting/travel node is a PC screen (11980 LOC, 45 files) for travel applications and travel expense allocation. The excerpt from TravelExpenseAllocationBatch.vue shows a batch workspace where users assign invoices and bills to the BO of a trip. It shows totals for pending and allocated amounts, flags rejected lines with reasons, and lets users edit the travel type. The node calls pc:api/accounting, pc:api/bpm, pc:views/accounting/expense and pc:views/bpm/processInstance. The packet lists 0 INCOMING edges, so no callers are recorded.

children.name: pc:views/costopenning
children.description: pc:views/costopenning is a PC screen (LOC 2598, 8 files). Its excerpted costCorrection/index.vue lets users search expense detail rows, run a posting check (checkStatus PASS, FAIL or PENDING), view 修改记录 change history, and upload correction lists. Each upload is tracked as an import batch with totalRows, appliedRows and errorRows. The screen calls pc:api/accounting, pc:views/accounting/components, pc:views/accounting/costCollection and pc:views/costopenning/components, and it has 0 INCOMING callers. The packet does not show which backend endpoints or tables it reads or writes.

children.name: pc:components
children.description: pc:components is the shared component module at psa-front-desk-pc/src/components (111 files, 13016 LOC). Its file names suggest it provides workflow-modelling widgets such as ProcessDesigner.vue, ProcessViewer.vue, FlowCondition.vue and UserTaskListeners.vue, plus captcha verification widgets. In the excerpt, Verify.vue routes 'blockPuzzle' to VerifySlide and 'clickWord' to VerifyPoints. It has two outgoing edges: call->pc:api/bpm and dispatch->system:controller/admin/captcha. The packet lists 0 incoming edges, so it does not show what uses this module.

children.name: pc:utils
children.description: pc:utils is a 1937-LOC module of 27 files under psa-front-desk-pc/src/utils that holds shared helpers for the PC front end. The index.js excerpt shows table date formatting (formatDate), relative-time display (formatTime), URL query handling (getQueryObject, param2Obj, param) and string helpers (byteLength, html2Text). File names such as request.js, auth.js, permission.js, dict.js and manhour.js suggest request, auth and dictionary support, but the packet does not show their code. Its only OUTGOING edge is call->pc:api/login. The packet lists INCOMING (0), so no callers are recorded.

children.name: pc:views/components/dialog
children.description: pc:views/components/dialog is a 2869-LOC set of 11 shared modal screens for project task work, such as editTask_module.vue, addProjectTask_module.vue, resources_module.vue, gantts_module.vue and contactsChose_module.vue. The editTask_module.vue excerpt shows a task form that, on create, picks 条款, then 交付包, then 任务包 (refs #1215), and also lets the user choose a 资源. It calls pc:api/project, pc:api/public, pc:api/system and pc:views/project/weeklyMeeting. It is called by seven nodes, including pc:views/project/planning, pc:views/project/taskLists and pc:views/dashboard/home.

children.name: framework:common
children.description: framework:common is a shared utility module (2942 LOC, 60 files) under psa-backend/yudao-framework/yudao-common. It holds no business logic of its own. Instead it gives the rest of the backend common helpers: collection conversion in CollectionUtils.java, date handling in DateUtil.java and LocalDateTimeUtils.java, JSON via JsonUtils.java, the CommonResult.java result type, and errors through ServiceException.java and GlobalErrorCodeConstants.java. It has 0 OUTGOING edges. It has 269 INCOMING call edges from callers such as bpm:service/task, bpm:controller/admin/task, bpm:framework/flowable, framework:apilog and framework:datapermission.

children.name: pc:views/infra/build
children.description: pc:views/infra/build is a 2592-LOC screen at psa-front-desk-pc/src/views/infra/build, made of 11 files led by RightPanel.vue, index.vue and FormDrawer.vue. The RightPanel.vue excerpt shows a property panel with 组件属性 and 表单属性 tabs. In it a user sets a component's 字段名, 标题, 占位提示, 默认值 and 表单栅格, so the node appears to be a form builder. It has OUTGOING (0) edges. Its only INCOMING edge is a call from pc:views/bpm/form. The packet does not show where finished forms are saved.

children.name: fst:domain/presales
children.description: fst:domain/presales is the presales domain module (36 files, 2133 LOC). It is built around the Quotation aggregate root, which covers psa_quotation and its child tables for detail lines, the cost tree and seals. It also holds CostTemplate and OpportunitySnapshot. Its Javadoc says only DRAFT/REJECTED quotes can be edited, submitting sets PENDING, and only PENDING quotes can be decided. Its single OUTGOING edge calls fst:quotation/enums. Its 7 INCOMING callers include fst:application/presales, fst:application/delivery, fst:controller/admin/quotation, fst:controller/admin/opportunity and fst:service/workflowform.

children.name: pc:views/project/quotation
children.description: The pc:views/project/quotation screen (11 files, 3238 LOC) is the PC quotation module. Its largest file, CostEstimateTree.vue, renders a cost-estimate tree of clauses, deliverables and work packages. There, users pick a city and a template, enter clause amounts or percentages against the final quote, and assign roles whose rates are then applied. Other files include editor.vue and approvalView.vue. It calls pc:api/bpm, pc:api/project and pc:api/system. It is called by pc:views/project/budget, pc:views/project/costTemplate, pc:views/project/opportunity and pc:views/project/pmList.

children.name: bpm:service/task
children.description: The bpm:service/task module (2074 LOC, 10 files, led by BpmTaskServiceImpl.java and BpmProcessInstanceServiceImpl.java) runs workflow tasks and process instances. For example, getTodoTaskPage builds a user's pending-task list, and mergeRowApprovalTasks groups row-approval tasks into one entry. Of its 34 outgoing edges, it calls bpm:framework/flowable, bpm:dal/mysql/task, bpm:mq/producer, fst:api/workflowhook, fst:api/manhour, system:api/user and system:api/dept. It reads ds:bpm_task_ext, ds:bpm_process_instance_ext, ds:bpm_process_definition_ext and ds:bpm_oa_customized. It is called by bpm:api/task, bpm:controller/admin/task, bpm:controller/app/task, bpm:framework/flowable and bpm:service/oa.

children.name: fst:application/delivery
children.description: fst:application/delivery is a module (LOC 4343, 94 files) of use cases for running delivery projects. It covers progress task operations through OperateProgressTaskUseCase, plus budget, deliverable and ETC approval flows such as StartBudgetRevisionUseCase, LockProjectBudgetUseCase, SubmitDeliverableUseCase and DecideEtcApprovalUseCase. It calls framework:common, framework:security, fst:application/platform, fst:domain/delivery, fst:domain/presales, fst:enums and fst:dal/mysql/contract. It reads ds:psa_pm_contract and ds:psa_pm_contract_term. It is called by fst:controller/admin/pmproject, fst:application/receivables, fst:mq/consumer, fst:service/workflowform and fst:trigger/task.

children.name: fst:controller/admin/pmproject
children.description: fst:controller/admin/pmproject (2573 LOC, 30 files) is the admin API for project delivery management. Its main part is WBS budget compilation in PmProjectBudgetController at /fst/pm-project/budget, which covers import, task-package edits and a lock step that submits the budget for PM_BUDGET approval. It also has controllers for project progress, deliverable submission and revenue confirmation. It makes 11 outgoing calls, to fst:application/delivery, fst:application/receivables, fst:domain/delivery, fst:domain/receivables, fst:service/user, fst:controller/admin/user, fst:enums, bpm:api/annotation, framework:security, framework:datapermission and framework:common. Its only incoming edge is pc:api/project->dispatch.

children.name: fst:domain/delivery
children.description: The fst:domain/delivery module (49 files, 4076 LOC) holds the delivery domain model. Its centre is ProjectBudget.java, a project budget aggregate made of clauses, deliverables and task packages (TaskPackage.java). The module also contains DeliverableSubmission.java and DeliverableProgress.java. The excerpt shows that budget editing is blocked once wbs_budget_locked is set or approval is PENDING. Saving submits a PM_BUDGET approval, and rule violations throw BudgetRuleViolation. Its one OUTGOING edge calls fst:util. Its 6 INCOMING callers are fst:application/delivery, fst:controller/admin/pmproject, fst:infrastructure/delivery, fst:infrastructure/receivables, fst:service/workflowform and fst:trigger/task.

children.name: fst:infrastructure/delivery
children.description: fst:infrastructure/delivery is a 3239-LOC module of 14 files that holds the delivery-side repositories, queries and approval starters. Its largest file, ProjectBudgetRepositoryImpl.java, appears to load a project's WBS budget tree and apply role cost rates. Approval starters include BudgetApprovalStarterImpl.java and DeliverableApprovalStarterImpl.java. The packet records 55 OUTGOING edges but lists only some. Listed calls include bpm:api/task, fst:domain/delivery, fst:dal/mysql/project, fst:dal/mysql/quotation and system:api/user, and it reads ds:psa_bd_customer, ds:psa_budget_deliverable and ds:psa_budget_task_package. INCOMING is 0, so no callers are recorded.

children.name: fst:service/project
children.description: fst:service/project (9 files, 2160 LOC) is the project service module. ProjectServiceImpl pages and lists projects and adds manager, department and customer names to them. It sets modificationRights for a project's manager, its delivery manager or any user with the BU项目总监 role. Judging by their names, ProjectPayServiceImpl and InvestForecastServiceImpl handle project pay and invest forecasts. Its 67 outgoing edges include calls to fst:dal/mysql/project, fst:dal/mysql/customer, fst:service/contract, fst:service/wip and framework:security. It is called by 7 nodes, including fst:controller/admin/project, fst:controller/app/project and fst:trigger/task.

children.name: fst:service/wip
children.description: fst:service/wip (8 files, 2099 LOC) appears to handle WIP carry-forward accounting. In WipServiceImpl.java, getWIPCarriedOverList loads CarryForwardDataDO and CarryForwardDataWorksDO rows for a year and month. It totals their amounts by cost type, such as 工时, 日常费用, 差旅费用 and 委外, combines them with CuValueDO output values and attaches voucher numbers from U8cVoucherDO. Its 68 OUTGOING edges include call->fst:dal/mysql/wip, call->fst:dal/mysql/u8c, call->fst:dal/mysql/voucher and call->fst:service/accounting. It has 6 INCOMING callers, including fst:controller/admin/accounting, fst:service/manhour and fst:service/sync.

children.name: h5:pages/work/project
children.description: The h5:pages/work/project node is a screen (4332 LOC, 8 files) in psa-mini/src/pages/work/project for recording work hours. Its files are addManhour.tsx, editManhour.tsx, assignManhour.tsx and teamAssignHours.tsx, which by their names appear to add, edit, assign and team-assign hours. addManhour.tsx saves unsubmitted drafts under MANHOUR_DRAFT_V1. The node calls h5:api/fst, h5:api/project and h5:api/task. The excerpt shows getWorksSpace, getWorksSpaceWbs2, addManHour and isWorkday imported from '@/api/project/manhour'. INCOMING (0) lists no callers.

children.name: pc:views/project/lists
children.description: The pc:views/project/lists node is a PC screen (2977 LOC, 8 files including performance.vue, profit.vue, budget.vue, overview.vue and wip.vue) that appears to show project financial dashboards. The performance.vue excerpt displays gauges and tooltips for 完工百分比, CPI, 完工预算（BAC）, 挣值（EV）, 应计收入（ACR） and 实际成本（AC）. It makes 4 outgoing calls: pc:api/project, pc:api/system, pc:views/components/sublists and pc:views/dashboard/mixins. It has 0 incoming edges, so the packet does not say what calls this screen.

children.name: pc:views/project/planning
children.description: pc:views/project/planning is a screen (1866 LOC, 5 files including index.vue, project.vue and planLists.vue) for editing a project's work plan. The excerpted detail view shows project header fields and an editable tree table of 阶段名称, 工作包 and 工作项. Each row has 是否关键任务, planned dates and 分配工时（小时）. The view also offers 从预算一键导入, 保存, a 甘特图 view, and template import (从其他项目引入, 从计划模版导入). It makes 4 outgoing calls: pc:api/project, pc:api/public, pc:api/system and pc:views/components/dialog. The packet lists 0 incoming callers.

children.name: pc:views/project/pmList
children.description: The pc:views/project/pmList screen (7 files, 3456 LOC: progress.vue, budget.vue, view.vue, index.vue, ProgressImportDialog.vue and two constants files) appears to be the project manager's project workspace. Its excerpted progress.vue renders the "项目进度" page, which shows a cost banner (budget, incurred, ETC, forecast, savings, cost POC) above an hours-progress tree of clauses, deliverables and task packages, where task packages can be assigned. It calls pc:api/project, pc:api/system, pc:views/project/deliverable, pc:views/project/quotation and pc:views/project/revenue. It is called by pc:views/project/budget.

children.name: pc:views/project/weeklyMeeting
children.description: The pc:views/project/weeklyMeeting screen has 4 files and 2522 LOC. It appears to support weekly project meetings. Its create/index.vue view shows the year, week (第 {{ title.weekNumber }} 周) and groupName. Per project, it lists 完成情况 and plans 下周任务 by 工作包, 工作项, 工时（小时） and 人员, with 保存, 发送, 添加项目 and 分配情况 actions. It calls pc:api/project, pc:api/public, pc:api/system and pc:views/components/dialog, and pc:views/components/dialog calls it back. The packet does not show which endpoints it reads or writes.

children.name: fst:controller/admin/manhour
children.description: The fst:controller/admin/manhour module (3905 LOC, 29 files) provides the admin man-hour endpoints, such as ManHourController and ManHourWCheckController. It also holds repair tooling. FixPsaTimeSheetWorks fixes old dirty rows held in psa_time_sheet_works_error: fixTypeA restores missing rate fields, and fixTypeF recovers approved_time. It calls fst:service/manhour, fst:dal/mysql/manhour, bpm:api/annotation and system:api/user. It reads psa_time_sheet, psa_time_sheet_works, psa_time_sheet_approve_status_revision and bpm_process_instance_ext, and writes bpm_oa_customized. It has 6 incoming callers, including fst:controller/app/manhour, fst:service/sync and fst:service/wip.

children.name: fst:service/manhour
children.description: fst:service/manhour (4063 LOC, 18 files) is the man-hour service layer. Through ManHourServiceImpl, ManHourItemServiceImpl, ManHourApproveStatusService, ManHourPostingCheckServiceImpl, ManHourEndServiceImpl, ManHourRevisionService, ManHourBpmApplyService and TimeSheetRateServiceImpl, it appears to handle man-hour approval status, posting checks, revisions, BPM applications and rates. children.name: fst:service/resource
children.description: fst:service/resource is the backend module for project resource planning. It manages plans, plan works, plan templates and tasks. In ResourceServiceImpl, getTaskPage works out how busy each billable user is by dividing their assigned task hours by the theoretical hours for the workdays in the period. acceptTask appears to accept tasks inside a transaction. It calls framework:mybatis, framework:security, fst:dal/mysql/resource, fst:dal/mysql/calendar, fst:dal/mysql/manhour, fst:service/calendar and fst:service/budget. It is called by fst:controller/admin/resource, fst:controller/app/task, fst:api/project and fst:service/manhour.

children.name: pc:views/project/manhour
children.description: pc:views/project/manhour is a screen of 3716 LOC across 2 index.vue files, where users fill in their timesheets. The excerpt titles it "工时填报（APP 同款流程）" and walks through 日期 → 总工时 → 选工作包 → 分段 → 提交. The user picks a 工时日期 (with 昨天/今天 shortcuts) and a 当日总工时. They then split hours across 工作包 with 工作详细 remarks and submit through submitManHour. Its only OUTGOING edge is call->pc:api/project, and INCOMING lists 0. The packet does not show which endpoints or data are involved.

children.name: pc:views/project/timesheet
children.description: pc:views/project/timesheet is a screen (2199 LOC, 6 files, including create.vue, choseJob_module.vue and choseOp_module.vue) where staff enter and review timesheets. The excerpted detail/index.vue shows a header with the timesheet date, name, department and post. Below it is an editable grid where users add project (insertJob), opportunity (insertOp) and non-billable (insertFree) hour rows, enter declareHours, and see approvalHours and each row's approveStatus (3 shows a check, 2 a cross). The screen calls pc:api/bpm, pc:api/project, pc:api/public and pc:api/system, and the packet lists 0 incoming callers.

observations: Cost、Delivery、Timesheet、Presales 四个域双向 import（例如 COST→DEL 85 次、DEL→COST 20 次），实为一个耦合簇；按域拆分前必须先在新架构里定义它们之间的 api / events 契约。
fst 与 bpm 在构建期和运行期互相依赖（bpm-biz 依赖 fst-api；bpm 通过 WorkflowHook / WorkflowForm Feign 回调 fst；fst 通过 Feign 调 bpm），bpm 还按表名直接回写业务表（bpm_oa_customized 有 11 个写入节点）。审批应当作为一个独立的平台能力重建，而不是原样迁移。
写入方最多的表：psa_pm_project（14 个写入节点）、bpm_oa_customized（11）、psa_time_sheet_works（8）、psa_reliable_delivery_task（7）、system_dept（7）。这些是新系统里需要明确唯一所有者的数据。
framework:common 被 269 个节点调用，framework:mybatis 被 118 个节点调用；yudao 底座渗透到所有业务代码，迁移时不宜保留底座，应换成目标栈的原生机制。
fst 中新的 DDD 分层（application/domain/infrastructure，16.4 万行，有测试）反向 import 老的 dal/service（100 个文件）；新分层可作为规则抽取的主要来源，老 service 层（ManHourServiceImpl 等）需要重点做特征测试。
前端有 69 个 URL 解析不到 Controller（动态拼接或已删除的接口），另有 34 个 Controller 生产 180 天零调用；按功能界定迁移范围时，这两份清单是剪枝依据。
没有发现「因反射或按约定命名的依赖注入而无法判定」的死代码：所有 service、application 节点都有入边；疑似废弃的是零调用的 Controller 及其专属服务（见 live_code_prod.json）。

flows.name: 员工填报工时并获批
flows.persona: 项目成员 / 部门经理
flows.description: 项目成员每天在手机或电脑上把当天工时分配到工作包，经审批后计入项目人工成本。

steps.label: 在 H5 或 PC 上选择日期、工作包并分段填报工时
提交工时，校验额度并落库
发起工时审批，经理在待办中通过或驳回
审批结果经消息回写工时状态
定时任务计算人天与费率，工时进入成本归集

flows.name: 报价获批后转为项目预算
flows.persona: 售前经理 / 项目经理
flows.description: 售前经理为商机编制成本估算和报价并送审，赢单后项目经理以报价为基线编制 WBS 预算并锁定。

steps.label: 按模板和城市编制成本估算树与报价
项目经理导入报价、编制 WBS 预算
锁定预算并发起 PM_BUDGET 审批

flows.name: 出差申请、订票与报销分摊
flows.description: 员工在手机上提交出差申请，经审批后在分贝通订票，月底财务把账单和发票分摊到项目。

steps.label: 在 H5 填写行程并提交出差申请
审批通过后同步到分贝通（可靠投递）
财务在 PC 端把账单和发票分摊到项目 / 商机

flows.name: 月末成本归集、结转与凭证
flows.description: 月末成本会计归集当期直接和间接成本、分摊 OH、结转 WIP，并生成凭证推送用友 U8C。

steps.label: 按公司和期间执行成本归集，处理异常
OH 分摊与结转试算（MQ 异步批处理）
确认过账，生成凭证草稿并写总账
WIP 结转与凭证推送 U8C
